title: ModularGen
summary: A tabular synthetic-data generation research codebase that dispatches across multiple generator methods (CTGAN, TVAE, GaussianCopula, CopulaGAN, custom HCTGAN/HTVAE/ZoneStat variants) and evaluates them with quality and privacy metrics. It vendors and extends the SDV and ctgan source trees in-tree, directly calling sdv.single_table synthesizers, sdv.metadata, and sdmetrics' QualityReport/DCRBaselineProtection for training, sampling, and scoring.
evidence: tab_main.py:15 imports CTGANSynthesizer/TVAESynthesizer/GaussianCopulaSynthesizer/CopulaGANSynthesizer; dispatcher at line 128 maps method names to these classes and calls .sample()
needs: Vendored ctgan/ and sdv/ trees contain custom additions (HCTGAN, HTVAE, ZoneStatSynthesizer) — unclear if these are original SDV-family contributions or purely local forks; no author/affiliation info available in truncated README.
